article.title: Vocabulary quiz: pick the correct synonym
article.description: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.
article.content: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.

generated.caption:
Ever feel happy but want a different, slightly more sophisticated word? 🤔 Our quick quiz found that 'Content' is a great synonym for HAPPY!

It means you're satisfied and pleased with your situation. For example: "She felt content with her new job." It's perfect for IELTS and daily conversations!

Save this for your vocabulary bank and follow @EnglishVault for daily tips! ✨
generated.script: Happy ka sahi synonym choose karte waqt kabhi confuse hote ho na? Toh suno, Happy ka best synonym hai 'Content'. Iska matlab hai ki you are satisfied aur happy with your current situation. Aap apni haalat se khush aur satisfied ho. Ye IELTS jaise tests mein bahut common pairing hai. So next time, Happy ka synonym 'Content' hi choose karna. Ab clear hai na? Comment mein batao, ye tip aapko pata thi? Follow The English Vault for more!

slides.body: The adjective 'content' describes feeling satisfied and happy with your current situation. It's a common synonym pairing often found in vocabulary quizzes and English proficiency exams like IELTS. Unlike intense joy, being content suggests a more peaceful and quiet sense of fulfillment. For instance, 'He felt content just watching the sunset after a productive day.'
slides.hindiSummary: कंटेंट (Content) का अर्थ है अपनी स्थिति से संतुष्ट या प्रसन्न होना।
